visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young man in a light grey suit jacket and black undershirt standing on an outdoor rooftop balcony. He has short, styled dark hair and is looking thoughtfully at a black smartphone in his right hand while touching his chin with his left. Behind him is a dense urban skyline with several high-rise buildings, some of which are under construction with blue safety netting. A green potted plant is visible in the lower right foreground. (2) A hand enters the frame from the right side, pointing at the man's phone screen. The man turns toward the camera with a startled and wide-eyed expression, his mouth open as if caught off guard. He then begins to smile and laugh, waving both hands in a dismissive 'no' gesture. The camera stays in a medium shot, capturing his upper body and the surrounding city context. (3) The man holds his phone up to the camera, revealing a Japanese language learning application on the screen. He gestures enthusiastically with his hands as he speaks directly into the lens. A digital meme overlay featuring a panda face and text appears intermittently over his chest area. He points to the phone and then back to himself, maintaining a very high-energy and expressive facial performance. (4) The visual transitions to a series of fast-paced screen recordings and graphic overlays. These include the interface of a banking app called 'CUBE', lists of travel discounts, and logos for companies like EVA Air, Cathay Pacific, and Klook. Images of Japanese tourism spots, such as Universal Studios Japan and Mt. Fuji, are displayed alongside promotional text. The background for these graphics is mostly a clean, off-white digital interface. (5) The scene returns to the rooftop where the man is now seen wearing a large brown leather backpack and carrying a silver hardshell suitcase. He looks toward the camera with an excited grin, gesturing for the viewer to follow him. He turns and walks toward a glass sliding door leading inside the building. The handheld camera follows his movement closely as he exits the rooftop area, waving one last time.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a clean field recording of a male voice speaking in a neutral, inquisitive tone in Mandarin. There is a very faint background bed of urban city ambience, but no music. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect cuts in as a second male voice shouts 'Hey!' with high vocal arousal and a playful, teasing inflection. This is followed immediately by the main speaker's laughter. (3) A high-energy electronic pop BGM kicks in with a clear 4/4 drum beat at approximately 128 BPM. The main speaker begins a rapid-fire delivery in a mix of Mandarin and English, his voice sounding much more projected and excited. (4) A series of 'ding' sound effects and digital UI chimes occur in synchronization with on-screen graphical changes. A synthesized 'panda meme' voice effect repeats a short Japanese phrase with a humorous, toy-like timbre. (5) The speaker maintains a high speech rate as he describes financial benefits. The music stays consistent in the background, balanced below the vocal track. A 'car engine revving' SFX is heard briefly when F1 racing is mentioned. (6) The video concludes with the speaker shouting 'Let's go!' with maximum volume and energy. A final percussive 'thump' SFX marks the end of the promotional segment, and the audio fades out with a digital 'shing' sound.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Interaction -> Information Pitch -> Benefit Breakdown -> Call to Action -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Cathay United Bank CUBE credit card's travel rewards and a collaborative promotion with Cola Tour for trips to Japan and a chance to win a trip to see an F1 race. The video uses a humorous 'distracted teacher' skit to grab attention before pivoting into an energetic explanation of card benefits and a giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the credit card, app interface, and detailed explanation of rewards and lucky draw rules.
